name: Royal Red
tagline: Deep imperial crimson vignette with antique gold corner brackets, hairline rules, a vermilion seal and widely tracked Cormorant Garamond capitals (extended from a single-slide specimen)

palette.description: oxblood red radial gradient with antique gold accents, cream text and a vermilion seal

typography.style: high-contrast serif capitals with wide letter-spacing over a light clean sans body

best_for: Ceremonial, heritage and luxury presentations that need gravity and a sense of occasion. Suits sparse, centered statements and a few strong numbers.
avoid_for: Casual team updates or text-heavy working sessions where the heavy ceremony would feel out of place.
